## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/date-time",
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/date-time').par.date` (an input) and `op('/date-time').out.date` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.date`, `out.date`.
